scope: Standalone sites (native unless a coast is set), no river or coast unless stated, lot occupancy 1, default period. Fabric street blocks classified by centroid: inside the outer wall, shanty ward, roadside ribbon (within 32 m of an approach band beyond 0.8 of its glacis), or ring (the rest beyond the wall). Modes: current lot test; inside = no lot beyond the wall; full = every lot beyond the wall kept.
